what: Catchment Attributes and Meteorology for Large-Sample Studies - Peru (CAMELS-PE) Data Management
title: Catchment Attributes and Meteorology for Large-Sample Studies - Peru (CAMELS-PE) Data Management
text: goal rcamelspe provide efficient user-friendly R interface download, load, filter, manage CAMELS-PE (Catchment Attributes Meteorology Large-sample Studies - Peru) dataset. CAMELS-PE includes daily meteorological hydrological time series, static catchment attributes, geospatial representations 136 catchments distributed across Pacific, Atlantic, Titicaca hydrographic regions Peru. manage volume records (2.2 million rows daily climate data), package designed using: - arrow: high-performance reading large files. - collapse: fast data frame subsetting, selection, binding, join operations.

text: gauge_ids Character vector. Station/catchment identifiers (e.g. "PE_110139"). NULL (default), loads timeseries 136 catchments. variables Character vector. Names hydroclimatic variables select.
